summary: AI.GENERATE_BOOL generates boolean scalar values for filtering, scoring, and counting workflows; BigQuery ML now supports the AI.GENERATE_BOOL function for Gemini-based text analysis with boolean output.
extended_definition: AI.GENERATE_BOOL generates boolean scalar values for filtering, scoring, and counting workflows; BigQuery ML now supports the AI.GENERATE_BOOL function for Gemini-based text analysis with boolean output.
